desc: The cross Simon of Cyrene was forced to carry: 'they forced him to carry the cross of Jesus' (Matt 27:32).
name: the cross of Jesus

desc: The soldiers at the crucifixion: 'When the soldiers had crucified Jesus, they divided His garments into four parts, one for each soldier' (John 19:23).
name: the soldiers who crucified Jesus

desc: 'they divided His garments into four parts, one for each soldier, with the tunic remaining' (John 19:23).
name: the garments of Jesus

desc: 'many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to minister to Him' (Matt 27:55).
name: the women who watched from a distance

desc: The stone at the entrance of the tomb: 'the stone had been rolled away' (Mark 16:4), 'removed from the entrance' (John 20:1).
name: the stone of the tomb

desc: The tomb Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see (Matt 28:1) and Peter ran to (Luke 24:12).
name: the tomb of Jesus

desc: The adversary of Job 1-2 and Zechariah 3:1-2: 'the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan also came with them' (Job 1:6). The Berean prints the Hebrew word as the name Satan; the Hebrew has the article, ha-satan, 'the adversary', and the figure stands among those who present themselves before the LORD (Job 1:6, 2:1) and 'at his right hand to accuse him' (Zech 3:1). The New Testament's 'that ancient serpent called the devil and Satan' (Rev 12:9) is on the card of the devil. Whether the adversary of Job and Zechariah is that figure is a reading the text of Job and Zechariah does not make, and readers differ; this card does not decide it, and the two cards are not merged.
name: the adversary

desc: 'In my vision in the night I continued to watch, and I saw One like the Son of Man coming with the clouds of heaven. He approached the Ancient of Days and was led into His presence.' (Dan 7:13). The Gospels' 'Son of Man' sayings at Matt 24:30, Matt 26:64 and Mark 14:62 use these words (the Berean editors' note at Mark 14:62 and the allusion layer).
name: One like the Son of Man coming with the clouds of heaven

desc: Jesus' answer to the high priest: 'I am, and you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming with the clouds of heaven' (Mark 14:62); Matt 26:64 has 'coming on the clouds of heaven'. The Berean editors note that Mark 14:62 quotes Dan 7:13.
name: you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power and coming with the clouds of heaven

desc: 'Now Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother had named him Jabez, saying, Because I bore him in pain' (1Chr 4:9). His prayer: 'If only You would bless me and enlarge my territory! May Your hand be with me and keep me from harm, so that I will be free from pain' (1Chr 4:10), and 'God granted the request of Jabez'.
name: Jabez

desc: The mother of Jabez, who 'had named him Jabez, saying, Because I bore him in pain' (1Chr 4:9). The text does not name her.
name: Jabez's mother

desc: 'Jabez was more honorable than his brothers' (1Chr 4:9).
name: more honorable than his brothers

aka: the Spirit of the Lord GOD
desc: The Hebrew Bible's own phrase, in its own voice: 'the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters' (Gen 1:2); 'the Spirit of the LORD came upon' Othniel, Gideon, Jephthah, Samson, Saul and David (Judg 3:10, 6:34, 11:29, 14:6; 1Sam 10:10, 16:13); and 'do not take Your Holy Spirit from me' (Ps 51:11). The Hebrew word is ruach, 'spirit, wind, breath', and Jewish tradition has heard the phrase in several ways, commonly as God's own presence and power at work. The New Testament attributes some of the Hebrew Bible's words to the Holy Spirit (Acts 28:25, of Isaiah; Heb 3:7, of Psalm 95). The Hebrew Scriptures do not themselves identify this Spirit with the New Testament's Holy Spirit, though they use the words 'Holy Spirit' (Ps 51:11, Isa 63:10); the two cards are linked as possibly the same.
name: the Spirit of God
disambiguation: the Spirit of God as the Hebrew Bible names it; the New Testament's Holy Spirit has a card of its own, linked to this one as possibly the same
